concept.literalSynthesis: The vampire-spark wand identity is joined to the stitched vampire suit as a wearable charm that still casts a blood ember. The supplied parents identify a wand of vampire spark and a stitched vampire suit; no additional parent appearance is assumed.
concept.coreMechanic: Use the charm to launch one 12-damage magic ember every 26 ticks (about 0.43 seconds), for 4 mana per active use. It travels toward the cursor from beside the owner, curves downward under gravity, and ends on its first NPC hit or solid-tile contact, with a 1.5-second lifetime. A successful hit heals the owner by 10% of damage dealt, capped at 1 HP per hit. While equipped as an accessory, it grants 2 defense and 0.5 HP/s life regeneration; those benefits require wearing it and do not apply from holding it. The source wand supplies the 12 magic damage, 26-tick tempo, 4-mana cost, and gravity ember identity; the source suit supplies the wearable vampire-suit identity and a 0.5 HP/s regeneration precedent. The 2 defense points are a new, explicit accessory effect requested for this design, not a parent observation. Both parent recipe metadata report generation depth 0, so no progression tier is inferred. The item retains the source wand's Blue rarity, 40000-copper value, and single-item stack. Its light is an authored red ember glow.
concept.parentAContribution: The supplied vampire-spark wand is a 12-damage magic item with a 26-tick use interval and 4 mana cost. Its blood ember is a 12-damage cursor-aimed projectile with gravity, a 1.5-second lifetime, red light, and an on-hit heal of 10% of damage capped at 1 HP. These identity and combat details inform the new cast.
concept.parentBContribution: The supplied stitched vampire suit is an accessory whose authored effect includes 0.5 HP/s life regeneration. Its wearable vampire-suit identity and regeneration inform the passive role. The new 2 defense points are explicitly added for this design; the source suit itself has zero defense.
concept.playerExperience: Cast a slow, gravity-curved ember with cursor aim; hits can return a small amount of life, capped at 1 HP each. The 4-mana use cost and 26-tick cadence retain the wand's tempo. Equip the item to gain 2 defense and 0.5 HP/s regeneration; holding it grants no defense.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Cast one red-lit, cursor-aimed magic ember for 4 mana; its 12 base damage, downward gravity, single-hit limit, short lifetime, and capped on-hit healing make it a deliberate ranged attack rather than a free healing source.
Wear the vestment in an accessory slot for 2 defense and 0.5 HP/s life regeneration. These are equipped benefits only.

realization.description: Use the vestment to cast a red-lit ember toward the cursor. It deals 12 base magic damage and falls under gravity. On an actual hit, it heals you for 10% of damage dealt, up to 1 HP. It costs 4 mana per active use, repeats at a 26-tick interval, and expires after 1.5 seconds; the first NPC hit or solid-tile contact ends it. Wear it as an accessory for 2 defense and 0.5 HP/s life regeneration. Holding it does not grant the equipped benefits.
realization.playerExperience: A modest, mana-priced ranged shot pairs with a small, capped hit heal. The accessory's defense and regeneration are available only while equipped.
realization.selfEvaluation: Runtime mechanics are authored explicitly: one reusable primary cast and one equipped passive; the body itself has no contact damage. The projectile has a single-hit policy, explicit gravity, lifetime, collision and healing. The accessory explicitly supplies positive defense and regeneration.
